name: documented narrow literal fallback retains an accurate diagnostic

before.CONTRACT.md: A missing preference uses the system default. Other failures must propagate.

after.cache.rb:
def preference(cache)
  cache.fetch(:preference)
rescue KeyError
  'system'
end
after.CONTRACT.md: A missing preference uses the system default. Other failures must propagate.

expected.message: Error handling was added or changed to suppress a failure instead of propagating it.

name: another specific exception and literal retain the diagnostic

after.cache.rb:
def preference(cache)
  cache.fetch(:preference)
rescue MissingPreference
  "automatic"
end

expected.message: Error handling was added or changed to suppress a failure instead of propagating it.
